## What happened?

Describe the behavior and what you expected instead.

## How can it be reproduced?

Provide the smallest reproducible sequence, including the TaskDrop commit or
release, Node.js version, client name and version, and deployment shape.

## Verification

Include relevant error categories or redacted logs. Do not include a Space Key,
Authorization header, credential-bearing URL, database URL, private Handoff
Markdown, or other personal or secret data.

For a security vulnerability, do not submit this form. Follow
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) and report it privately.
